Subject: Concierge three-way demo — availability & DST edge cases

Hi Susan —

Thanks again for the interest and for carving time to look at the platform. We want to run a short concierge-style session where an engineer from our EU team (Vivek) pairs with me to walk through: production routing, cost controls (batching/quantization), and the private deployment checklist you asked about.

Two small constraints that affect timing: Vivek is based in Berlin (CEST) and that team prefers to avoid very late evenings; Greenfield mentioned there may be one APAC observer on the call who needs to avoid overnight hours. Also, DST boundaries next week mean some of the usual slots shift for a handful of attendees.

Can you confirm whether you prefer: 1) an earlier US slot (08:00–10:00 ET), 2) mid-morning ET (10:00–11:30 ET), or 3) late evening ET (20:00–21:30 ET) on any of these days: Tue 6/22, Wed 6/23, Thu 6/24?

If none of those work, we can propose a rotating host arrangement (Vivek will handle the technical walkthrough and I’ll handle business context) and record the session for participants who can only watch the recording. We can attach a brief ops sheet and pre-read ahead of time.

I attached a short opsheet that outlines what we plan to demo and the data points we’ll show.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks Jordan —

Appreciate the detail. A few quick notes from our side: our execs block early mornings until 10:00 ET, so option 1 is tough. Mid-morning (10:30–11:30 ET) is ideal for the core team (Susan / Alan / product lead). We also have a technical observer in Seoul who would prefer not to be on a call between 02:00–07:00 KST (so late evening ET is possible but not great if it pushes past 21:30 ET).

To summarize preferences: 1) Avoid before 10:00 ET for exec participants, 2) avoid 02:00–07:00 KST for APAC observer.

We can do Wed 6/23 10:30–11:15 ET if that works for your engineer team. Recording is fine; please share the recording and any short notes. Also — we’ve started a quick SOC/security checklist; attaching a doc with three follow-ups (IAM, data retention, audit logs).

Thanks,
Susan Hartman
VP, Digital Transformation
Greenfield Health
susan.hartman@greenfieldhealth.com
